02 QUANT / GPU

Monte Carlo,
accelerated.

An option-pricing engine with CPU, CuPy, and custom CUDA implementations. Includes analytical validation, Greeks, and variance reduction.

PythonNumPyCuPyNumba / CUDA
The approach +

Combines Black–Scholes and Heston models with finite-difference Greeks. CPU, CuPy, and custom CUDA implementations make their performance comparable.

The résumé reports a peak 57× GPU speedup at five million simulations, with benchmarking up to ten million runs. Results depend on hardware and benchmark conditions.
